# v0.5.2 — Settings polish, packaging fixes and maintenance

## Settings cards

- Text inputs and selects in settings cards are now properly styled
  (consistent height, borders and background) — visible in the
  excluded-folders editor and language picker
- Disabled controls across settings cards show a clear dimmed state
  with a not-allowed cursor

## Fixes

- Theme apply/download spinner class is now generic — any button can
  show the loading state without theme-specific selectors
- Findings rows expose their path (`data-path`), fixing row identity
  across table re-renders

## Packaging

- AUR `PKGBUILD` now tracks the current release (it had been stuck on
  v0.1.0 since the first packaging attempt)
- Whitespace cleanup in the command registration table

## Under the hood

- The optional AI assistant feature moved to a dedicated development
  branch (`wip/ai-assistant`) while it matures — it is **not** part of
  this release, keeping 0.5.x fully AI-free as before
